# Consumed TLS plaintext/material owner controls

Pass the pinned native Node26.13 binary, matching source directory and a
private output directory to run-controls.sh through scripts/dev-shell.sh.
This small Darwin component uses the exact portable headers and genuine
native Node/OpenSSL/TCP for orderly EOF, unexpected EOF and close/delivery
reentry. It checks retained actual bytes, pause/resume, publication retry,
actual ticket identity, stale acknowledgement rejection and native frees.

The reference also observes real native TCPWRAP/TLSWRAP constructor order,
the genuine retained-parent hasPendingRead proxy, and the actual extracted
curated release forwarder with an expected pre-admission fault boundary.
No fake handle, provider, ref flag or successful native admission is supplied.

These are component/source controls. They do not compile or execute the
SpiderMonkey bridge, actual Promise hooks/realm/GC/Worker behavior, public
onread/AsyncWrap scope, guest TLS, browsers or HTTPS Agent activation.
The true early TLSWrap/retained TCP/Socket/async ownership remains required.
